findings.description: `frequency + title_bonus if term in title_terms else 0.0` parses as `(frequency + title_bonus) if term in title_terms else 0.0`. Every term absent from the title gets a score of 0.0 instead of its frequency. With the default empty title, all scores are 0.0 and the ranking falls back to alphabetical order. suggest_tags then filters on `score >= MIN_SCORE`, so it returns no suggestions for most articles. The scores that are returned are also wrong.
findings.suggestion: Write `scores[term] = frequency + (title_bonus if term in title_terms else 0.0)`.
